issues.explanation: auth+verified are on the initial GET routes but no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for verified is in the diff, so Livewire update requests may skip the verified check after the initial page load.

Strict === comparison between session current_entity_id and integer entity id can fail if the session value comes back as a string, leaving a stale current_entity_id after self-removal or entity deletion.

Audit Log::channel('audit')->info is written inside the DB::transaction closure before commit, so a commit failure would leave a transfer log for a transfer that rolled back; log after the transaction.
Concurrent duplicate addMember via firstOrCreate race would surface as QueryException from the unique index rather than the specified validation error on email.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/* authorize via Gate inside each action; Members email uses #[Validate]+validate(), Settings slug via rules()+validate(); Entity/EntityMembership policies used everywhere; migrations have reversible down(); #[Fillable] set; Blade uses <x-entity-nav>/<x-form-field>/<x-button> and {{ }} only; docs/database-schema.md, docs/business-rules.md and CHANGELOG.md updated

readability.evidence: app/Actions/TransferOwnership.php: demote-first comment; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php: roleIn helper; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php: membershipOf protected resolver; small focused methods, clear names, no dead code

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/*: entities_slug_unique, entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner; Entity::getRouteKeyName slug, owner() query, UserRole::manageable; EntityPickController audit+redirect; Dashboard/Members/Settings mount authorize, owner notice, tampered-id 403, last-manager 403, transfer atomic demote-then-promote, slug unique-ignore

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task.md: models, enum, policies, actions, pick controller, 3 Livewire components + views, routes, lang keys, factories, migrations, docs/CHANGELOG, 7 test files; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: Members::addMember authorize update, assignRole authorize assignRole + Rule::in(manageable), removeMember authorize delete + membershipOf entity-scope check; Settings entity #[Locked] + authorize manageSettings on every action; views use {{ }}; mass assignment via #[Fillable]; gaps are limited-impact: verified not persisted, === session compare, log inside tx

simplicity.evidence: One Action per use case (AddMember, AssignRole, RemoveMember, UpdateEntity, DeleteEntity, TransferOwnership); reads stay as Eloquent in render(); no service/repository layers, no speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entities/DataModelTest.php, PolicyTest.php, PickEntityTest.php, DashboardTest.php, MembersTest.php, SettingsTest.php, EntityLangTest.php cover happy path, validation errors (email exists, role in, slug unique), unauthorized calls (employee add/assign/remove, admin settings, non-member 403) and tamper tests (foreign membership id, Locked entity swap, blank/vanished owner transfer)

review.summary: Adds entities/memberships data model with DB-enforced single owner, policies, entity pick with audit, and Livewire dashboard/members/owner-only settings pages with extensive Pest coverage. Thorough, convention-following change with only limited-impact nits (verified persistence, strict session compare, log placement), so approve with nits.
